review_candidates.title: Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Department: Digital & Technology Platform Services, Data and AI Insights Location: New Cairo, Egypt We are expanding our team and seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, solid knowledge of machine learning, experience with modern software delivery practices, and a curious mindset toward artificial intelligence applications to join our Analytics Engineering team within the Digital & Technology Platform Services (DTPS) organization at Coca Cola Hellenic. In this role, you will contribute to shaping the strategy, design, and development of advanced analytics solutions that deliver meaningful insights and support data driven decision making across the business. You will be part of the Data Insights and Artificial Intelligence (DIAI) team, integrating and transforming data into scalable, analytics ready solutions and cutting edge machine learning applications. YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: • Design, develop, implement, and optimize scalable, high performance, secure, and cost efficient data pipelines using Microsoft Azure cloud services and large scale data technologies, including Apache Spark and PySpark built with object oriented programming principles. • Load and process data from Azure Data Lake, orchestrate Azure Databricks jobs, and manage Azure Data Factory pipelines with a high degree of proficiency. • Develop and implement robust data quality frameworks to ensure data integrity across all stages of the data lifecycle. • Perform data profiling, analysis, and validation to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data quality issues in a timely and effective manner. • Implement security, governance, and access control measures to safeguard sensitive data within Microsoft Azure environments. • Build and maintain machine learning workflows and data pipelines that support model development, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. • Use approved AI coding coding agents to support requirements analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, documentation, debugging, and code review, while retaining full accountability for the resulting code. • Translate product requirements into clear, bounded engineering tasks containing the relevant architecture constraints, interfaces, dependencies, edge cases, security requirements, and acceptance criteria before delegating work to an AI coding agent. • Utilize Git based version control to manage code repositories, apply structured branching strategies, and enable collaborative development practices. • Apply Agile methodologies to plan, prioritize, and deliver data engineering work in iterative development cycles. • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for data solutions, including data models, data flows, architectural diagrams, and detailed technical specifications. • Stay up to date with Microsoft Azure data services, large scale data tools, DevOps practices, and broader industry best practices, providing recommendations for adoption and continuous improvement. • Work closely with DevOps teams to implement and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines for Azure based applications and data workflows. • Support Microsoft Power Business Intelligence developers by evaluating and optimizing data connection methods and data transfer strategies, ensuring high performance, scalability, data quality, and security. ARE THESE YOUR SECRET INGREDIENTS? • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience), • Two or more years of professional experience; Microsoft Azure Data Engineer certification is considered an advantage. • Strong understanding of secure software development and modern software delivery practices, including continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, automated deployments, and extensive experience using Git for version control • Expertise with Microsoft Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure Databricks, with solid experience applying performance optimization techniques for analytics and reporting workloads. • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark using object oriented programming, along with strong skills in Python and SQL to design and optimize scalable data pipelines across largescale data architectures that handle big data. • Experience in using AI coding agents across implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation, while retaining ownership of code quality and technical decisions. • Skilled in context engineering: creating clear task specifications and curating the relevant code, architecture constraints, standards, examples and tool access required for reliable AI-assisted development. • Knowledge of Systems, Applications, and Products Business Warehouse extractors, transformations, and data export processes, along with experience working within Agile and Scaled Agile Framework environments. • Proven ability to ensure data quality, reliability, and operational efficiency, supporting advanced analytics and ML workflows. • A foundational understanding of machine learning concepts, feature engineering, and machine learning operations for model deployment and monitoring. ABOUT YOUR NEW TEAM: We are Coca-Cola Hellenic, a growth-focused consumer goods business and strategic bottling partner of the Coca-Cola Company. We bottle, distribute and sell an unrivalled range of products in 29 markets in Europe, Africa and Eurasia. As we do, we create value for all stakeholders, support socio-economic growth and build a more positive environmental impact. We bring together more than 30,000 people from over 70 nationalities, coming from five continents. The diversity of our markets, from mature to emerging economies, provides a wide range of attractive opportunities for growth. We nurture our talents. We give opportunities to people across all functions and levels, as well as different geographies, backgrounds and education. We are willing to take a risk on the people we believe in, even if they don’t have the perfect experience. We have faith in what every person can be. And although we have so much to be proud of, we always stay humble. We believe the real magic happens - for us and for you - when we OPEN UP. AT COCA-COLA HBC, DIVERSITY HELPS US THRIVE At Coca-Cola HBC, we are an inclusive employer that thrives on diversity. This means our environment provides equal opportunities for all, regardless of race, color, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. Join us in nurturing a culture where everyone belongs and contributes to our collective success.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: STR is hiring experienced Senior Software Engineers to join our multidisciplinary cyber/networking team committed to developing cutting-edge technologies that have an immediate and significant impact on our national security. Our team innovates communications technology across all networking layers, from the physical to the application layer. We value diverse skills, experiences, and perspectives, which are vital to delivering innovative solutions to our customers. If you have a strong track record of delivering impactful software solutions and meet the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply! Job Overview: A successful candidate will possess several years of practical experience in software engineering, integration and testing, and networking concepts and protocols. They will demonstrate a proven ability to take ownership of technical challenges and deliver results in collaborative, fast-paced environments. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of computer science concepts, sound software engineering principles, and hands-on experience working on Linux systems. Experienced engineers at STR are expected to work independently while contributing meaningfully to team efforts and mentoring less experienced team members. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a high-profile, fast paced yet structured development environment alongside a diverse and talented team. In this role, you will take a leadership role in designing, implementing, and testing software that enhances advanced real-time data communications and networking solutions using open systems principles. We aim for the highest standards of quality, maintainability, and reuse in our tools and techniques. Therefore, candidates should have a demonstrated ability to produce well-designed, scalable solutions and to establish and follow reliable testing methodologies. What you will do: Collaborate closely with a small, dedicated research team to develop innovative solutions to complex problems Take ownership of significant features or components of projects and deliver them with minimal supervision Lead technical discussions, guide architectural decisions, and mentor junior engineers Develop and test novel software solutions spanning research, development, and deployed production systems Analyze and improve existing designs and processes to optimize performance Deliver high-quality software in a rapid-paced, research-focused team environment Develop operational prototypes for experimentation and performance analysis Create customer-facing operational systems, ensuring they meet high reliability and usability standards Who you are: This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by the U.S. Government 5+ years of experience in relevant software engineering roles Proficient in Python, C, C++, or similar interpreted or low-level programming languages Experienced with designing and implementing open architectures and rapid prototyping methodologies Strong working knowledge of software testing, evaluation best practices, and industry-standard development lifecycles Significant hands-on experience developing software with GNU/Linux toolchains using open-source software Deep understanding of networking principles, including the 5-layer OSI networking stack Strong team player with excellent communication skills, both verbal and written Bachelor's (or higher) degree in Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with at least 5 years of relevant experience or equivalent expertise gained through prior roles Nice to Have: Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance Advanced experience in Python, MATLAB, and/or other high-level programming languages Proven ability to build, deploy, and maintain production-ready software systems Experience writing software in a multi-party, large-scale codebase Demonstrated success managing technical challenges in experimental/laboratory environments, including performing quantitative analysis Familiarity with multi-threaded or multi-core real-time operating concepts Knowledge of high-level software architecture design and scalability principles Demonstrated leadership abilities, including mentoring junior staff and contributing to team efficiency Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $134,000 - $184,000 The salary range listed is based on external market data. Final offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions. STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, and Carlsbad, CA. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us. STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer. STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info. STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info. Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

review_candidates.title: GCP Cloud Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: JOB SUMMARY: This job is a strong advocate of cloud technology and engineering support necessary to drive the organization's next-generation technologies. The intermediate level incumbent works to adopt, expand, maintain, and optimize cloud usage across the organization through engineering support of cloud technologies and through automation builds and related technologies. The incumbent owns support and engineering of cloud solutions and must stay current with new cloud offerings to continue to produce expected corporate results. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: Engineer & implement cloud-based technical architectures, migration approaches, deployment of cloud resources and application optimizations that utilize automation technologies, sound redundant solutions and enable business objectives. Works to define cloud resource procurement and performance patterns through monitoring and tracking of usage and trends to optimize cloud spend & resource efficiency. Proposes ideas, designs, and solutions to senior or lead engineers to further cloud service utilization and optimization. Develops automation scripts and other repeatable patterns to enable application and service teams to deploy software and services into cloud environments. Performs research and analysis required for new cloud deployment proposals, existing cloud service modification, and other new cloud adoption to ultimately provide sound recommendations on best course of action. Level 2 Incident, problem and change management as it pertains to the responsibilities of the cloud operations engineering team. Develop documentation to support operations process, procedures and implementations. EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree in Cloud Computing, Computer & Information Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, or closely related discipline EXPERIENCE: 3 years with at least two modern programming languages (Java, JavaScript, BASH, PowerShell etc.) Experience doing operational support of at least one of the following cloud service providers for an organization: GoogleCloud Platform, Azure or Amazon Web Services. PREFERRED: Experience producing code that is fault-tolerant, efficient, and maintainable Experience designing, building, and deploying scalable cloud-based solution architectures through automation tools like Terraform or Ansible for example and versioning control via GitLab or similar tools. Experience with standard IT security practices such as identity and access management, data protection, encryption, certificate and key management Knowledge of containerization and container orchestration technologies such as Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). LICENSES or CERTIFICATIONS: GCP, AWS, Azure or other Cloud Service Certification SKILLS: Demonstrates ability to achieve stretch goals in a highly innovative and fast-paced environment. Ability to speak and write English fluently and idiomatically. Strong scripting experience along with interest and ability to learn other programming languages as needed. Gitlab or other versioning control tools and processes. Kubernetes or other Container orchestration technologies Terraform, Ansible, or other automation technologies Knowledge of infrastructure concepts, such as OS, Virtualization or Networking

review_candidates.title: Principal Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position: Principal Software Engineer Location: McLean, VA Role Overview The Principal Software Engineer owns end-to-end solution architecture across application, cloud, data, and AI domains, and stays hands-on in the codebase writing production code, building the hardest components, and reviewing the work of the engineering team. Architecture here is proven by building it, not by documenting it. Technical authority comes from setting direction, making the hard calls, shipping alongside the team, and raising the engineering bar through review and mentorship. The role is the most senior technical voice on the project and is accountable for the quality, security, and production readiness of what is delivered. Key Responsibilities Act as the technical leader for assigned projects: own the architecture end to end, set technical direction, and make the calls on frameworks, patterns, and trade-offs. Stay hands-on in the codebase, personally building the critical-path and highest-risk components rather than delegating them, and validating architecture decisions by implementing them. Translate business requirements, product objectives, and operational needs into architecture blueprints and working reference implementations the team can build against. Design and build production AI systems, including agent runtimes and orchestration, tool contracts and function calling, retrieval, guardrails and policy enforcement, evaluation harnesses, and the cost and latency controls that make them viable in production. Unblock the team: pair on complex problems, debug difficult production issues, and step into whichever layer of the stack is holding delivery up. Drive engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, technical standards, test strategy, and production readiness assessments. Design and build secure, resilient, cloud-native solutions on AWS, owning observability, performance, scalability, resilience, and cost-aware design. Ensure solutions follow secure-by-design principles and applicable compliance, privacy, and data protection standards, including how sensitive and personal data is handled. Collaborate across product, engineering, delivery, security, and client-facing teams, and support client discussions and pre-sales by shaping solution approaches, technology recommendations, and high-level effort estimates. Mentor engineers, document architecture decisions and their rationale, and lead knowledge transfer so teams can operate and extend the system independently. Required Qualifications 12+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or technical leadership roles, with strong experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade solutions. Currently hands-on: writing and reviewing production code as a regular part of the role, not solely producing designs and documentation. Strong proficiency in Python and working proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js, with a track record of clean, well-tested, maintainable code. Proven experience in solution architecture across distributed systems, APIs, service-oriented and microservice designs, event-driven and integration patterns, and cloud-native applications. Strong hands-on experience with AWS, including compute, storage, networking, security and IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and cost-aware design. Hands-on experience building AI-enabled systems in production, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows and tool use, guardrails, and evaluation. Working knowledge of data architecture concepts such as data modelling, governance, lineage, and secure data exchange, including support for analytics and AI use cases. Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes. Strong understanding of application and integration architecture, security principles, and non-functional requirements such as scalability, resilience, and performance. Experience leading engineering teams technically through design reviews, implementation guidance, and architecture governance, and influencing decisions without formal reporting authority. Experience translating business and client requirements into scalable technical designs and architecture roadmaps. Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and client audiences, and sound judgment in balancing architectural goals against practical delivery needs. Experience contributing to technical solutioning for proposals, statements of work, or client-facing solution discussions. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. AWS certification such as Solutions Architect Professional. Exposure to architecture and compliance considerations in regulated environments, including privacy, security, and audit controls. Experience in consulting, client delivery, or technical pre-sales environments.
